svg.text: One pass. A matched image leaves the pool, so each bracket only ever sees what the one above it could not claim.
SUPPORTING PARTS — used by the brackets, not brackets themselves
Every LAMBDA + FamilyRecords from the IEM
one filename token equals a family numeric value, exactly.
TCD 0, fixed confidence 1.0. No edit-distance tolerance, ever.
in-order tokens concatenate to exactly the family value.
Ranked by fewest tokens used; accepted while TCD ≤ maxDistance.
accepted only when the image matches exactly one family AND that
family has no matched record with the same phenotype yet.
candidates limited to families with zero images so far.
CLIP ProductType is a hard filter, ProductColor a conditional one;
numeric tokens narrow, string tokens score. One winner ≥ SemanticThreshold.
no rename; the original filename is kept as provenance in the manifest.
Still a candidate for two or more families → MATCHES_MULTIPLE_FAMILYIDS.
Ties are not resolved by det position. An image that stayed a candidate for more than one family is KO'd, deliberately —
a V1 decision to be revisited once there is more match signal to weigh.
